messages.subject: Problems with function occu
parts:

1L, 0L, 0L)), .Names = c("y.1", "y.2", "y.3", "y.4", "y.5", "y.6", 
"y.7", "y.8", "y.9", "y.10"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, 
-21L))

Organize data

site.covs = v[, c("cob", "dp", "dc")]

datos = unmarkedFrameOccu(y = p, siteCovs = site.covs)

Fit model

> mod1 <- occu(~ 1, ~ 1, datos)
Error in occu(~1, ~1, datos) : Data is not an unmarkedFrameOccu object.

[1] "unmarkedFrameOccu"

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Problems with function occu
parts:
Hi Manuel,

You need "~1 ~1" instead of "~1, ~1". The "double formula" is a bit odd, and I wish we have never implemented it in the first place.

Richard
